canary.selection: strictly greatest valid macro_f1; earliest tie; test metrics only after selection
canary.sample_rule: SHA256(rmea-sample-v1:split:original_id), ascending; pilot reuses pinned readiness-v1 train/valid selection
canary.primary_utility: ordered minus static full40 test macro_f1; positive is provisional single-seed gate only
canary.primary_mechanism: ordered selected-checkpoint CE(branch train-mean)-CE(actual), CE(branch role-swap)-CE(actual), CE(branch whole-split deterministic mismatch)-CE(actual); all samples retained
canary.controls: Retrained no_content and symmetric; classical_pair equal active parameter count, not proven capacity/optimization equivalence
canary.replication: Never automatic. Owner audits single-seed report before any multi-seed release.
canary.private_policy: Report-only Git return; no exchange authorization required; private evidence stays collaborator-side
canary.claim_scope: Frozen encoder output head; no L3, novelty, hardware, speedup, quantum exclusivity or statistical claim from a single seed
